cohort: Women with and without spina bifida who were hospitalized for delivery between 2003 and 2013.
finding: The number of deliveries among women with spina bifida is significantly increasing, and over a quarter of the deliveries occur by age 22, with significant differences in the characteristics and mode of delivery compared to women without spina bifida.
mod_finding: Women with spina bifida were significantly more likely to undergo a caesarean section (52.4% vs. 31.9% of those without, p < 0.001).
